intent: Distinguish finger away from sharp edge without injury claim, thumb pressing page, pack high on back, chest rising versus box or downward, stomach pain after a ride without causal proof, apron around waist, injured leg on cushion without healed claim, gently landing on one knee.

workshop.title: 找准部位，摆对位置和动作

transfer.stem: 换成电线、徽章和脚，哪组三句保留了全部要求和事实？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
让电线远离发热的表面。把徽章戴在胸前较高的位置。她轻轻地单脚着地。
词语提示：cable 电线；surface 表面；badge 徽章；foot 脚。

options.text: Keep the cable touching the hot surface. Wear the badge high on your chest. She landed gently on one foot.
Keep the cable away from the hot surface. Wear the badge high on your chest. She landed gently on one foot.
Keep the cable away from the hot surface. Wear the badge low on your chest. She landed gently on one foot.
Keep the cable away from the hot surface. Wear the badge high on your chest. She landed heavily on both feet.

answer.display: Keep the cable away from the hot surface. Wear the badge high on your chest. She landed gently on one foot.

explanation.strategy: 分别核对远离关系、高低位置，以及数量和动作方式。
